name: issue_674_constraint_comment
description: Dump dropped COMMENT ON CONSTRAINT for table constraints, including a partition's own comment on its inherited primary key copy
notes: Constraint comments are read from pg_description (obj_description(oid, 'pg_constraint')) and emitted after the statement that creates the constraint.
A partition's copy of a parent's PRIMARY KEY/UNIQUE constraint does not inherit the parent's comment; each copy carries its own, emitted with the explicit constraint family.
